Name: Kenneth's Cake Slices
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Adds 9 custom cake slices to Kenneth's Dessert Shop - golden custard tart slice, chocolate yule log slice, rich dark chocolate cake slice, vanilla chip blondie log slice, rustic apple crumble pie slice, vanilla sprinkle cake slice, pink strawberry layer cake slice, strawberry ribbon cake slice, and strawberry shortcake slice - each with its own cooking recipe and buffs![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requires Kenneth's Dessert Shop - this mod's items are sold in its Shop1.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Customization: By default, all cake slices appear in Kenneth's Dessert Shop. If you want to customize your selection and have Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) installed, you can disable individual cake slices to remove them from the shop along with their cooking recipes. Re-enabling a cake slice restores it to the shop and its recipe to your kitchen.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]More details can be found in ReadMe.txt.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Please do not reupload this mod or include it in modpacks without permission.[/b][/size]
